Summon Simulation Mechanics

How the Empires & Puzzles Summon Simulator Works

Every portal page in this directory uses the exact configuration snapshots and appearance rates from Empires & Puzzles. Understanding the mathematical mechanics ensures you make smart, informed summoning decisions.

⚖️

Two-Stage Probability Hierarchy

When you initiate a summon, the simulator first determines the outcome rarity bucket (such as Featured 5★, Standard 5★, Epic 4★, or Rare 3★) based on the portal’s stated percentage odds. Once a bucket is determined, an eligible hero is picked uniformly at random from that category’s pool.

🌟

Independent Bonus Draws (HOTM & Secret)

Hero of the Month (HOTM, ~1.3%) and Secret Summons (~0.1%) operate as completely independent bonus rolls. Each draw has an autonomous chance to trigger a bonus, which is awarded alongside your primary summon outcome without replacing it.

🎲

Realistic Multi-Pull Randomness

10-pulls and 30-pulls simulate true consecutive RNG draws. Because each pull is mathematically independent, doing 30 or even 100 pulls does not guarantee a 5★ hero. Testing simulations reveals the reality of variance and prevents the Gambler's Fallacy.

💎

Resource & Budget Strategy

Gems and Summon Tokens are valuable. Simulating pulls gives you a clear sense of how many gems you would need to pull a desired hero. Pair this directory with our Pull Chance Calculator for detailed probability curves.

Empuzzled Pro Summoning Tips

  • Target Featured Portals Only: Non-featured pools are huge. Chasing a specific non-featured 5★ has odds often below 0.05%.
  • Time with Guaranteed Systems: Align standard summons with the Fated Summon meter to guarantee a 5★ hero after 100 pulls.
  • Save Duplicates: Keep duplicate Legendary heroes for the quarterly Soul Exchange event.
  • Plan Rotations: Check the Event Calendar to see when high-tier featured heroes appear next.
Frequently Asked Questions

Empires & Puzzles Summons FAQ

Everything you need to know about portal odds, simulation mechanics, and summoning value.

Q:What is the Empuzzled Empires & Puzzles Summon Simulator?

The Empuzzled Summon Simulator is an authentic, free web application designed for Empires & Puzzles players. It allows you to simulate 1x, 10x, and 30x summon pulls across all portals—such as Wilderness, Covenant, Seasonal, Black Friday, Tower, and Astral—using authentic in-game appearance rates, featured hero pools, and bonus draw mechanics without spending real Gems or money.

Q:Are the summon odds and hero pools in this simulator identical to the live game?

Yes! The simulator is powered directly by game configuration files and officially published appearance rate percentages. Rates for Featured Legendary (5★), Non-Featured Legendary (5★), Epic (4★), Rare (3★), and independent bonus draws reflect the official game numbers with complete mathematical fidelity.

Q:How do 10-pulls and 30-pulls work in the simulator?

Just like in Empires & Puzzles, a 10-pull or 30-pull executes multiple independent consecutive draws against the portal’s configured probability tables. Testing multi-pull batches helps you visualize streaks, inspect probability variance, and understand the realistic outcome distribution before committing in-game resources.

Q:How are Hero of the Month (HOTM) and Secret Summons calculated?

Hero of the Month (HOTM, ~1.3% base rate) and Secret Summons (~0.1% rate) are calculated as independent bonus draws on each individual pull. An independent bonus draw does not replace or reduce your primary pull; you keep your standard summoned hero plus the bonus hero.

Q:Can I view and simulate upcoming or past summon portals?

Yes! Using the interactive Portal Schedule selector above, you can choose any past or future game day. The directory will dynamically update to show the portals and featured hero lineups scheduled for that specific 07:00 UTC game cycle.

Q:Does the simulator guarantee a 5-star Legendary hero after a certain number of pulls?

No. Standard Empires & Puzzles portals do not have a built-in "pity system" or streak guarantee unless a portal explicitly includes special milestone rules. Every pull is statistically independent. However, you can track guaranteed mechanics in the live game, such as the 100-pull milestone in the Fated Summon event.

Q:Which summon portals offer the highest value for Gems?

Portals that exclude Classic (Season 1) heroes—such as Black Friday, Solstice Summon, Covenant Summon, and Astral Summons—typically provide the best return per Gem because every 5★ hero pulled is a premium event hero. Check our Should I Pull? guide and Hero Database to evaluate hero strength.

Q:How does running summon simulations help me save Gems and tokens?

Simulating 10, 30, or 100 pulls is the best way to experience statistical variance without financial risk. Seeing how often even a 10-pull yields no 5★ heroes prevents impulse summoning and helps you plan your summoning budget for events where featured heroes truly benefit your roster.
